παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
πεζοί: πεζός — on foot; masc. nom. pl.: ’foot-soldiers’
πεπάλακτο: παλάσσω — splash, spatter, besmear; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’was spattered’

πνείοντες: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., with an object: ’breathing (might)’
ποθὴ: ποθή — longing, want, need (+ gen.); fem. nom. sg.
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολλοί: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.: ’many’
πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause

πολυδαιδάλου: πολυδαίδαλος — much-wrought, intricately made; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θώρηκος
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

προσεφώνεεν: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνει)

πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative

πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πύρασον: Πύρασος — Pyrasus, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg. (Πύρασον)
πύργον: πύργος — tower, bastion; masc. acc. sg.
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς before a following enclitic (οἱ): ’lest somehow’

πῖπτε: πίπτω — fall; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπιπτε)
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σκαμάνδρου: Σκάμανδρος — Scamander, the river of Troy and its god; masc. gen. sg., with ἀρητήρ: ’priest of Scamander’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’

στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σώκοιο: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), proper name
σῶν: σῶς (σάος, σόος) — safe, sound; masc. acc. sg., contracted (σῶν = σόον): ’safe’

φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’

φαεινῆς: φαεινός — shining, bright; adj., fem. gen. sg.

χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; masc. acc. sg. χρόα
ψυχὴν: ψυχή — soul, life-breath; fem. acc. sg.

ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address

ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπάλμενος: ἐφάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (ἐπάλμενος = ἐφαλόμενος): ’leaping on (them)’
ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεβήσετο: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -σετο (= Attic ἐπέβη): ’mounted’
ἐπεπωλεῖτο: ἐπιπωλέομαι — go over, range along, review; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented and contracted
ἐπιβήσεο: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -σεο: ’mount’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔασε: ἐάω — let be, leave alone, allow; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴασε)
ἔβαλ: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔβαλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck, hit’
ἔβαλλον: βάλλω — throw, pelt, hit; impf. 3 pl. (1 sg. identical): ’kept pelting’
ἔβησαν: βαίνω — go, walk, set off; aor. 3 pl.: ’they went’
ἔγχεΐ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., instrumental, epic ἔγχεϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε): ’drove’
ἔλαφον: ἔλαφος — deer, stag; masc./fem. acc. sg.
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔξαγ: ἐξάγω — lead out; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ἔξαγ’ = ἔξαγε; Attic ἐξῆγε): ’led out’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’)
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg. · also Ἔρις — Strife, the goddess; fem. acc. sg.
ἔσσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσεσθαι)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔφεπε: ἐφέπω — pursue, press upon (poetic; Attic διώκω); impf. 3 sg. act.: ’pursued’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
ἕπον: ἕπω — be busy about, tend, dress (meat); impf. 3 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (= ἀμφέπον)
ἕσπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐ-σπ-ετο, root σεπ-), the augment absorbed: ’followed’
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠρήρειστο: ἐρείδω — press, fix, lodge; plpf. pass. 3 sg., epic reduplicated: ’was driven home’
ἠϋκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος (= ἐΰκομος) — fair-haired; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Βρισηΐδος · also agreeing with Ἑλένης: ’fair-haired (Helen)’ · also agreeing with Θέτιδος: ’fair-haired (Thetis)’ · also agreeing with Ἀθηναίης: ’fair-haired (Athena)’ · also agreeing with Ἥρης: ’fair-haired (Hera)’
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’brought’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤπια: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly, soothing; neut. acc. pl.
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤϋσεν: ἀΰω (= αὔω) — shout, call out; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, ν-movable: ’shouted’
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. voc. sg., a courteous address: ’hero!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς)
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε)
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰητῆρος: ἰητήρ — healer, physician; masc. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἰατροῦ)
ἰθύνομεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, steer, direct; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., short-vowel subj. (-ομεν for -ωμεν), hortatory: ’let us steer’
ἰκέλη: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὁμοία, ἐοικυῖα)
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’) · also ἰῷ = Attic μιᾷ, ’one’, dat. sg. agreeing with ἤματι (ἰῷ … ἤματι ’on a single day’)
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἱπποσύνῃ: ἱπποσύνη — horsemanship, skill with horses; fem. dat. sg.
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἱππῆες: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἵετο: ἵεμαι — hasten, be eager (+ dat./inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid. (middle of ἵημι ’send’)
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο)
ἵμασεν: ἱμάσσω — lash, whip (from ἱμάς ’strap’); aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀμφαλοέσσης: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (of a shield); fem. gen. sg., -όεσσα in the feminine, agreeing with ἀσπίδος
ὀρινομένους: ὀρίνω — stir up, throw into turmoil; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’thrown into turmoil’
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
ὀρώρῃ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, set in motion; perf. subj. 3 sg. (of ὄρωρα ’have risen, am stirred’), intrans.: ’be stirring’
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general clause · also + aor. subj. in a general temporal clause, with no κε: ’whenever’ (ὁπότε … στυφελίξῃ ’whenever it drives’)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
ὄλεθρος: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. nom. sg.
ὄρωρεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; perf. 3 sg. with ν-movable: ’has arisen’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄχθας: ὄχθη — bank (of a river); fem. acc. pl.
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’) · also ’so that’ + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν ’so that they might pass through’)
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὑσμίνῃ: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive, not the possessive
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’doing’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
